source: Observed live in FL Studio 2026 on macOS: Options › settings window (every tab), the render dialog, the Plugin Manager and the Patterns dialogs (session 14, 2026-10-22; screenshots docs/research/evidence/screenshots/fl-dlg-*.png). Earlier records: https://www.image-line.com/fl-studio-learning/fl-studio-online-manual/html/envsettings_audio.htm
notes: page = the settings tab or dialog; section = the header inside it; control = the widget; fl_default = the value seen on a default project. limeshot_setting names the field: settings.* = application settings (settings.json in the config folder), ui.* = per-session UI state, project.* = saved in the project, dialog.* = an option of a LimeShot dialog (not saved). Confidence as in keybindings.json.
